proof_body:
by
  intro a M L h h₁ h₂
  have hu : Filter.IsBoundedUnder (· ≤ ·) Filter.atTop a :=
    Filter.isBoundedUnder_of ⟨M, fun n => (abs_le.1 (h n)).2⟩
  have hl : Filter.IsBoundedUnder (· ≥ ·) Filter.atTop a :=
    Filter.isBoundedUnder_of ⟨-M, fun n => (abs_le.1 (h n)).1⟩
  exact tendsto_of_liminf_eq_limsup h₁ h₂ hu hl
target_source: ∀ (a : ℕ → ℝ) (M L : ℝ), (∀ n, |a n| ≤ M) → Filter.liminf a Filter.atTop = L → Filter.limsup a Filter.atTop = L → Filter.Tendsto a Filter.atTop (nhds L)
